title: The Classical Hall
description: Casts of the great sculptures of Greece and Rome, below the Rotunda. The casts are the Royal Cast Collection's (SMK - National Gallery of Denmark, Copenhagen), scanned and published by SMK in the public domain; each label names the original and where it stands.

works.title: Apollo Belvedere
works.year: Roman copy, c. 120-140 AD, after a bronze of c. 330-320 BC
works.notes: For three centuries the measure of ideal beauty; Winckelmann called it the highest ideal of art. Cast: SMK, KAS353.

works.artist: Agesander, Athenodoros and Polydorus of Rhodes
works.title: Laocoön and His Sons
works.notes: Unearthed in Rome in 1506 with Michelangelo looking on; the priest of Troy and his sons in the coils of the serpents. Cast: SMK, KAS385.

works.artist: Apollonios, son of Nestor, of Athens
works.title: Belvedere Torso
works.year: 1st century BC
works.notes: A fragment Michelangelo refused to complete; its twisting strength lives on in the Sistine Chapel. Cast: SMK, KAS402.

works.title: Venus de Milo (Aphrodite of Melos)
works.notes: Found on the island of Melos in 1820; her lost arms have kept her a question ever since. Cast: SMK, KAS434.

works.title: Barberini Faun (Sleeping Satyr)
works.year: c. 220 BC
works.notes: A drunken satyr asleep on a rock, his body utterly abandoned: the Hellenistic eye for the unguarded moment. Cast: SMK, KAS208.

works.title: Discobolus (The Discus Thrower)
works.year: Roman copy after a bronze of c. 460-450 BC
works.medium: Cast after a Roman marble copy
works.collection: Original bronze lost; Roman copies in Rome and London
works.notes: The athlete caught at the still point between the backswing and the throw. Cast: SMK, KAS1074.

works.title: Doryphoros (The Spear Bearer)
works.year: Roman copy after a bronze of c. 440 BC
works.medium: Cast after a Roman marble copy
works.notes: Polykleitos's Canon made flesh: the proportions of the ideal body, and the weight shifted onto one leg. Cast: SMK, KAS11.

works.title: Augustus of Prima Porta
works.year: Early 1st century AD
works.notes: The first emperor as a general addressing his troops, his breastplate a map of Rome's peace. Cast: SMK, KAS65.

works.title: Dying Gaul
works.year: Roman copy after a bronze of c. 230-220 BC
works.notes: A defeated warrior sinking onto his shield: the victors of Pergamon honoured their enemy's courage. Cast: SMK, KAS1312.

works.title: Capitoline Venus
works.year: Roman copy, 2nd century AD, after a Hellenistic original
works.notes: A descendant of the Aphrodite of Knidos, the first life-size nude goddess in Greek art. Cast: SMK, KAS493.

works.title: Homer (the blind type)
works.year: Roman copy after an original of c. 150 BC
works.collection: Roman copies in Munich, London and Rome
works.notes: No one knew Homer's face; the Hellenistic age imagined the blind poet, and the image has stood for him since. Cast: SMK, KAS210.

works.title: Zeus or Poseidon of Artemision
works.year: c. 460 BC
works.notes: Raised from a shipwreck off Cape Artemision in 1928; the god's thunderbolt or trident long lost from his hand. Cast: SMK, KAS2100.

works.title: Sleeping Ariadne
works.year: Roman copy, 2nd century AD, after a Hellenistic original
works.collection: Original: Vatican Museums, Galleria delle Statue
works.notes: Abandoned by Theseus on Naxos, asleep before Dionysus finds her; once taken for Cleopatra. Cast: SMK, KAS134.

works.title: Lansdowne Heracles
works.year: Roman copy, c. 125 AD, after a Greek original of the 4th century BC
works.notes: Found at Hadrian's Villa at Tivoli in 1790; the hero with his club and lion skin, youthful and serene. Cast: SMK, KAS224.

works.title: Belvedere Antinous (Hermes)
works.year: Roman copy, 2nd century AD, after a Greek original
works.notes: Long taken for Antinous, Hadrian's favourite; now recognised as Hermes. For the eighteenth century, the canon of male proportion. Cast: SMK, KAS1161.

works.title: Capitoline Antinous
works.year: Roman copy, 2nd century AD, after a Hellenistic original
works.notes: The same Hermes type as the Belvedere figure, gentler and more inward. Cast: SMK, KAS824.

works.title: Minerva Giustiniani
works.year: Roman copy after a Greek original of the 4th century BC
works.notes: Athena helmeted and cloaked, a serpent at her side; once the Giustiniani family's pride. Cast: SMK, KAS255.

works.title: Farnese Diadoumenos
works.year: Roman copy after a bronze of c. 430 BC
works.notes: An athlete tying the victor's fillet round his head: Polykleitos's canon in motion. Cast: SMK, KAS79.

works.title: Lateran Sophocles
works.year: Roman copy after a bronze of c. 330 BC
works.notes: The tragedian as the model citizen, wrapped in his cloak, poised and grave. Cast: SMK, KAS633.

works.title: Socrates
works.year: Roman copy after a Greek portrait of the 4th century BC
works.notes: The philosopher's snub nose and satyr's brow, which his friends said hid a god within. Cast: SMK, KAS635.

works.title: Plato
works.year: Roman copy after a portrait of c. 370 BC
works.notes: The founder of the Academy, by tradition portrayed by Silanion. Cast: SMK, KAS2111.

works.title: Euripides (Farnese type)
works.year: Roman copy after a Greek portrait of c. 330 BC
works.notes: The third of the great tragedians, lined and brooding. Cast: SMK, KAS620.

works.title: Homer (Epimenides type)
works.year: Roman copy after a Greek portrait of c. 460 BC
works.notes: An earlier, calmer image of the poet than the Hellenistic blind Homer. Cast: SMK, KAS2237.

works.title: A general, identified as Kimon
works.year: Roman copy after a Greek portrait of the 5th century BC
works.notes: A helmeted Athenian strategos; the name is a scholar's suggestion. Cast: SMK, KAS534.

works.title: The so-called Seneca
works.year: Roman copy after a Hellenistic portrait
works.notes: Long believed to be the Stoic philosopher; perhaps an image of the poet Hesiod. Cast: SMK, KAS94.

works.title: Alexander the Great as Helios
works.year: Hellenistic, 2nd century BC
works.notes: The conqueror as the sun god, head tossed back, hair like rays. Cast: SMK, KAS283.

works.title: Ptolemy II Philadelphus
works.year: 3rd century BC
works.notes: King of Egypt, founder of the Library of Alexandria's great age. Cast: SMK, KAS752.

works.title: Philip the Arab
works.year: Roman, 244-249 AD
works.notes: An emperor of a crisis century, his frown carved with a new, hard realism. Cast: SMK, KAS2147.

works.title: Chrysippus
works.year: Roman copy after a Greek portrait of c. 200 BC
works.notes: The Stoic logician, who, it was said, wrote more than seven hundred books. Cast: SMK, KAS602.

works.title: Marcus Aurelius as a youth
works.year: c. 140 AD
works.notes: The future philosopher-emperor at about eighteen. Cast: SMK, KAS1090.

works.title: Zeno of Citium
works.year: Roman copy after a Greek portrait of the 3rd century BC
works.notes: The founder of Stoicism, who taught in the Painted Stoa at Athens. Cast: SMK, KAS745.

works.title: Antoninus Pius in a toga
works.year: c. 140 AD
works.notes: Emperor of Rome's calmest reign, draped as a citizen. Cast: SMK, KAS596.

works.title: Septimius Severus in a toga
works.year: c. 200 AD
works.notes: The emperor from Leptis Magna, with his forked beard. Cast: SMK, KAS683.

works.title: A lady of the Severan court
works.year: c. 200 AD
works.notes: Her hair in the waved, helmet-like style of the empress Julia Domna. Cast: SMK, KAS687.

works.title: Julius Caesar
works.year: Roman portrait
works.notes: The dictator's lean, lined face, as the Romans remembered it. Cast: SMK, KAS297.

works.title: Head of a Gaul
works.year: Roman copy after a Hellenistic original
works.notes: The Pergamene sculptors' noble enemy: tousled hair, moustache, defiance. Cast: SMK, KAS796.

works.title: Julia Titi
works.notes: Daughter of the emperor Titus, her curls built up in the Flavian fashion. Cast: SMK, KAS866.

works.title: Head of an Amazon (Sciarra type)
works.year: Roman copy after a Greek statue of c. 440 BC
works.notes: From one of the wounded Amazons made for Ephesus, when, the story goes, the great sculptors competed. Cast: SMK, KAS615.

works.title: Athena Parthenos
works.year: After the gold-and-ivory statue of 438 BC
works.notes: A reflection of the lost colossus that stood in the Parthenon. Cast: SMK, KAS2272.

works.title: Head of Apollo Giustiniani
works.year: Roman copy after a Greek original
works.notes: The god's calm, oval face, framed by long curls. Cast: SMK, KAS616.

works.title: The Oxford bust
works.year: Roman
works.notes: A woman with her right breast bared: an Amazon or a goddess. Cast: SMK, KAS106.

works.title: Dying Slave
works.notes: Carved for the tomb of Pope Julius II and never placed there; a youth sinking into sleep or death, the block still rough at his back. Cast: SMK, KAS87.

works.title: Rebellious Slave
works.notes: The Dying Slave's companion for the same tomb, twisting against his bonds. Cast: SMK, KAS86.

works.title: Bacchus
works.notes: His first large statue, made in Rome at twenty-one: the wine god unsteady on his feet, a satyr stealing his grapes. Cast: SMK, KAS83.

works.title: Venere Italica
works.notes: Made to replace the Medici Venus when Napoleon carried it off to Paris; a goddess surprised at her bath. Cast: SMK, KAS793.
